title: IN WHICH PHILEAS FOGG AT LAST REACHES LONDON
summary_hover: Phileas Fogg is held in the Liverpool Custom House but is released when the real robber is caught, chartering a train to London too late.
summary_detail: Phileas Fogg is imprisoned in the Liverpool Custom House by Detective Fix, effectively ruining his chances of winning the wager. Passepartout is devastated, blaming himself for not warning Fogg about Fix's true motives. Fix suddenly returns with news that the real bank robber was caught three days prior. A freed Fogg knocks Fix down and charters a special train to London, but arrives five minutes late.
